lede.t: Drought covers 41.7% of the lower 48 states.

lede_sub.t: U.S. Drought Monitor, map of Nov 10, 2026. A week earlier it was 44.0%; a year earlier, 44.4%.

weather.t: Drought covers 41.7% of the lower 48. 66 counties have exceptional drought (D4) over half their land.

weather_sub.t: 233 counties moved to a worse drought level since Nov 3, and 389 moved to a better one.

land.t: Half the counties put land and buildings above $4,360 an acre (2022 Census). Recorded sales give a median in 313 counties.

grain.t: Corn bids sit a median 30 cents under Dec '26 futures in the 598 counties with an elevator we read.

program.t: For corn in 2026, the median county expects ARC-CO to pay $10.89 per base acre. ARC-CO is expected to pay more than PLC in all 2,238 counties with a call.

risk.t: Crop insurance paid a median $8.59 in claims per $100 of coverage a year, the last ten closed years.
